# @sectile/terminal API

Reference the public import paths exposed by @sectile/terminal.

Start with the [@sectile/terminal guide](/packages/terminal) for usage and examples. This page is the lookup reference for exact public import paths.

## Install

```sh
pnpm add @sectile/terminal
```
